Dashboard

Six views. Every answer.

The browser-based dashboard drives the full model chain live. Switch between tabs without losing state. Every change recalculates on the next run.

Mission & trajectory profile

Define launch site, suborbital or orbital target, apogee, altitude floor, launch angle, and flight path control. The trajectory renders as an altitude-vs-time schematic. ΔV budget breaks down injection, gravity, drag, and steering losses.

Stage architecture & engine detail

Full per-stage parameters: dry mass, propellant, wet mass, burn time, T/W at burnout. Engine selection from catalogue with Isp vac, thrust, O/F ratio, and feed configuration. COPV MEOP, pressurant mass, tank pressure all modelled.

Convergence status & run control

Each architecture shows its convergence state inline — ● CONVERGED · 1 iter — and the vehicle schematic updates to reflect geometry. One click runs the full model chain and updates all KPIs.

Under the hood

8 coupled models.
One convergence loop.

Each model reads from and writes to a single architecture JSON. Ownership is explicit. Traceability is automatic. The conductor orchestrates the full chain and closes the tank↔COPV convergence loop in the middle.

Tank ↔ COPV convergence loop closes automatically at the centre of the chain
EXAMPLE · ARCHITECTURE JSON READS
isp = arch.read("propulsion.isp_s.vacuum")
stages = arch.read("syson.num_stages")

arch.write("mass", {
  dry_mass_kg: 82,
  propellant_kg: 220,
  wet_mass_kg: 302
}, model="mass_model")
01propulsion_modelEngine selection, Isp vac/SL, thrust, O/F ratio, feed config, nozzle extension, engine mass and unit cost.performance
02tank_modelTank pressure, ullage mode and value, residuals, oxidiser and fuel density and temperature. Feeds the convergence loop.geometry
03pressurant_modelPressurant gas mass, volume, temperature and pressure schedule. Sizing driven by tank model output.geometry
04copv_modelCOPV MEOP, density, internal/external volume, mass, cost. Converges against tank model — the loop closes here.↺ loop
05mass_modelDry, propellant, and wet mass per stage. Structural fraction. Rolls up from propulsion, tank, pressurant, and COPV outputs.mass
06performance_modelΔV per stage, T/W at burnout, burn time, staging coast, trajectory integration, margin calculation, Kármán-line check.ΔV
07cost_modelEngine unit cost, total programme cost, cost-per-kg. Configurable cost drivers per component and stage.cost
08syson_modelAuthoritative product tree round-trip. Fetch, extract, compute, inject — SysON stays in sync with every run.SysON

Output

12 KPIs ranked.
Instantly.

Every variant gets the same 12 headline KPIs computed in the same run. Filter, sort, and rank by any metric or custom expression. Export to table, CSV, or JSON.

Extensible by config

Add a custom KPI by editing one config file. No code changes, no redeploy. Every architecture picks it up on the next run.

kpis:
  - id: "cost_per_kg"
    expr: "cost.total / performance.payload_kg"
    direction: minimise

Integrations

Your model. Our conductor.

If it can read JSON and return JSON, CONVERj can drive it. Engineers keep working in their native tools — the adapter handles translation.

Python

Native import

Any .py module exposing run(inputs) → outputs. No subprocess overhead. Full Python ecosystem available.

Excel

Interface sheet

Formulas live in Excel. Adapter reads the interface sheet and writes outputs back via openpyxl. No VBA required.

Java / JVM

Subprocess or API

JVM model via subprocess or REST bridge. Full JVM ecosystem — Kotlin, Scala, and legacy Java models all supported.

Any executable

Binary wrapper

Wrap any binary — FORTRAN, C++, MATLAB — with a JSON I/O contract. If it runs on the machine, CONVERj can drive it.

SysON integration
Authoritative product tree, always in sync
CONVERj fetches the product tree from SysON, extracts an architecture JSON, runs the model chain, and injects the results back — keeping SysON current with every run. Available on Professional and Enterprise plans.
